_comment: EXHIBITION mode: the Conductor runs on radxa-05, which is also the AZ-Epaper hotspot (10.42.0.1) and is CONTROL ONLY - no garment is assigned to it in the show; its own agent on localhost keeps a tile. The other units join the hotspot with static addresses radxa-NN -> 10.42.0.1NN. Copy this file to /home/radxa/exhibition/fleet.json on radxa-05 (radxa/EXHIBITION.md). It never travels with the workspace: /api/workspace/import keeps the receiver's copy. "hotspot" names the unit that IS the hotspot (the fleet-wide Wi-Fi switch tells it first towards AZ-Epaper and last towards the router); "passcode" is what every other host must give the page before it may change anything (the same as serve --passcode) - CHANGE IT. "speaker_volume" (0-100, default 70) is this host's loudness - the page's slider and the LCD write it back here.
